pr_title: Use servicePatch methods from cloud-provider repo in service-controller
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Fixes #87447

** Explanation **
PR #87217 added service patch methods to k8s.io/cloud-provider. These changes have been released in 1.18, So the code in service-controller can be updated to use this new helper function

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```
cc: @prameshj
